title: Superman #19 DC July 1988 Power Failure John Byrne John Beatty 50 Years
conditionDescription: Clean, bright covers with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Superman #19 (July 1988, vol. 2), DC Comics - "Power Failure." By John Byrne and John Beatty. Fifty Years of Superman cover banner. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: TSR Forgotten Realms Black Wizards (Douglas Niles) ad.

Condition: clean, bright covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
